objective: Add a fail-closed diagnostic to test the four-field CPVS metadata hypothesis against the published Table 4 membership without changing the production selector.
previous_knowledge_consumed: Issue #170 remains unresolved: the authoritative-Seq reconstruction yields 741,788 candidates versus 730,184 published members in the latest full run; official VizieR/CDS endpoints timed out in that run.
The four-field positivity rule gmag>0, rmag>0, Per-g>0, Per-r>0 has been proposed as a diagnostic hypothesis but has not been established as the authors' intended selection rule.
Table 4 numeric IDs must not be assumed to share the Table 2 Seq namespace; crosswalk published ZTF names to Table 2 Seq.
Synthetic parser tests are not evidence of real-data membership equivalence.

baseline.description: The current main baseline preserves the authoritative Table 2 Seq parser, finite-SNR guard, strict JSON diagnostics, frozen v0.2.0 model/features/class order/cutoff, and fail-closed scientific gate.

change.scope: Add a standard-library-only fixed-width Table 2/Table 4 diagnostic, synthetic regression tests, and a Persian runbook. Hash inputs and set differences; fail closed on malformed rows, wrong counts, duplicate/out-of-range IDs, or name/ID inconsistencies.
change.rationale: The four-field hypothesis can be tested from two compact published metadata tables without re-running the 31-minute photometric derivation or transferring raw light curves.

parser_regression_coverage.before: No dedicated standalone test for this two-table four-field hypothesis on current main.
parser_regression_coverage.after: 14 synthetic fixed-width fixture tests reported on the source branch; current-main CI and test result are pending.

measurement.trade_off: The diagnostic does not establish author intent, alter the selector, or claim science validation. It requires real published files supplied by an operator if the CI environment cannot reach CDS/VizieR.

evidence: Source branch commit 6a82fa7daba2fa8ef97ceea26dfc43b4f48d84c7 reports 14 synthetic tests, 668 full-suite tests, and clean Ruff checks; these results have not been independently reproduced on this new main-based head.
Current-main CodeQL, format, lint, product-scope, and lifecycle checks are running; source-backed jobs are intentionally skipped on this feature PR.
Latest full CPVS run 40873746342 failed to retrieve published Table 4 from all configured public endpoints due network timeouts and retained an UNRESOLVED result.
validation.blocker: Fresh current-head CI must pass. Then run the diagnostic against hash-identified real Table 2 and Table 4 files; review both set differences and SHA-256 values. A zero difference would establish equivalence on those files only, not prove author intent.
blockers: Run the new tests on current main and verify all applicable CI checks.
Acquire official Table 2 and Table 4 files and record SHA-256 hashes, exact row counts, Seq gaps, and set-difference counts.
Keep Issue #170 open until the real-data output is reviewed and publication-method ambiguity is documented.

root_causes: The latest source-backed workflow could derive 741,788 candidates but could not acquire Table 4 from configured public endpoints due connection timeouts.
The production derivation still does not reproduce the published 730,184 membership; this diagnostic is intended to test one hypothesis without tuning the production predicate.

findings: Published Table 4 membership must be crosswalked by normalized ZTF object name to the parent Table 2 Seq namespace.
A set-equivalence result is not proof of the historical authors' intent.
Synthetic tests prove parser logic only; real-data validation requires pinned source files and hashes.

open_blockers: Current-main CI must complete, including the cumulative lifecycle contract.
Real-data test and source hashes are not yet available.
Issue #170 remains an explicit scientific validation blocker.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not change CPVS production membership criteria, thresholds, model artifacts, features, or scientific acceptance criteria based on this diagnostic alone.
Do not close Issue #170 or claim scientific validation before real source-backed set comparison and review.
Preserve the frozen v0.2.0 baseline and v1.0.1 release artifacts.
